1.why: The UI uses a clean sans-serif typeface with clear letter and line spacing across all screenshots.

2.why: Instructions use sentence case with no italics, all-caps, or dense paragraphs.

3.why: The single-column card layout is uncluttered and appears properly sized for mobile screens.

4.why: All instructions are brief and written in plain language.

5.why: Email and mobile fields are pre-filled with example values and a note says to use the displayed details.

6.why: No long text blocks exist; the user can proceed with only short labels and one sentence of guidance.

7.why: No long codes or secrets are ever shown, so copy support for them cannot be observed.

8.why: No QR code or alternative to manual entry appears in any screenshot.

9.why: Standard input fields are present that could allow autofill, but no explicit password-manager or autofill behaviour is demonstrated.

10.why: STEP 1 OF 5 labelling and the prominent blue Continue securely button make the current step and primary action clear.

11.why: Only one main action (signing in) is requested per screen.

12.why: After submit an error appears, yet the system never states what happened beyond the vague message or what to do next.

13.why: The form remains editable so the user can retry the step with no penalty visible, although no codes are present to reveal or re-request.

14.why: The error 'Unable to sign in with those details' names a problem but supplies no fix instructions.

15.why: No timers or time limits are displayed on any screen for reading or entry.
